description: Literature-derived reference bands used by the correlation tool to classify user-supplied numeric values before the recommendation generator drafts a response. Bands are illustrative agronomic thresholds drawn from FAO/USDA soil classification conventions, not site-specific calibrations.

soil_organic_carbon.source: FAO Global Soil Partnership, Global Soil Organic Carbon Map technical guidance

bands.label: critically_low
bands.note: Very low organic matter; soil biology and structure likely severely constrained.

bands.label: low
bands.note: Below typical maintenance level for productive cropland.

bands.label: moderate
bands.note: Adequate but improvable; typical of many cultivated soils.

bands.label: good
bands.note: Healthy organic matter level supporting active soil biology.

bands.label: high
bands.note: High organic matter, often found in undisturbed or long-term organically managed soils.

rainfall_level.source: Standard aridity classification synthesized from FAO Land and Water assessments

bands.label: arid
bands.note: Water is the primary limiting factor for most interventions.

bands.label: semi_arid
bands.note: Moisture-competing interventions (e.g. water-hungry cover crops) carry real tradeoff risk.

bands.label: sub_humid
bands.note: Moderate water availability; most standard interventions viable.

bands.label: humid
bands.note: Water generally not limiting.

bands.label: very_humid
bands.note: Excess water management (drainage, waterlogging) may become the binding constraint.

bands.label: strongly_acidic
bands.note: Restricts nutrient availability and many soil organisms, including earthworms.

bands.label: acidic
bands.note: Below optimal range for most crops.

bands.label: near_neutral
bands.note: Optimal range for most crops and soil biology.

bands.label: alkaline
bands.note: May restrict micronutrient availability.

bands.label: strongly_alkaline
bands.note: Significant nutrient and structural constraints likely.

bands.label: non_saline
bands.note: No significant salinity constraint.

bands.label: slightly_saline
bands.note: Sensitive crops may show reduced yield.

bands.label: moderately_saline
bands.note: Many crop yields restricted.

bands.label: strongly_saline
bands.note: Only salt-tolerant crops viable.

bands.label: extremely_saline
bands.note: Cropping largely unviable without remediation.
